findings.title: ADR-003 audit.finding.regressed payload has undocumented originalClosePr field alongside documented regressionClosingPr
findings.detail: docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md line 135 defined the audit.finding.regressed payload as including both originalClosePr and regressionClosingPr. The explanatory note only documented regressionClosingPr (PR number of the original fix) as the camelCase equivalent of regression_closing_pr — leaving originalClosePr unexplained. Both fields appear to represent the same data, creating ambiguity for M4 implementers.
findings.fix_sketch: Removed originalClosePr from the payload. Clarified regressionClosingPr note to explicitly reference the closingPr field from the prior audit.finding.closed event, making the lineage unambiguous.
